title: Reward time is updated even when no rewards are sent
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  In `UniswapV3Staking` users can claim rewards by calling the `claimRewards` function. However, the `lastRewardTime` is always updated even when they get zero rewards:  ```solidity     function _claimRewards(uint256 noteId, StakeInfo storage stakeInfo, address recipient) internal {         require(dnft.ownerOf(noteId) == msg.sender, "You are not the Note owner");         require(stakeInfo.isStaked, "Note not staked");         uint256 rewards = _calculateRewards(noteId, stakeInfo); ->      stakeInfo.lastRewardTime = block.t
